project.name: Fishblitz
project.description: Top-down pixel art RPG built in Unity — fishing, birding, crafting, and survival mechanics in a local community drama about learning to live within limits.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Fishblitz development guide for AI agents: the eight design-philosophy principles (no villains/bad luck, restoration-as-adaptation, Presences kept ambiguous, narrative through play, biased storytelling, costly resources, slow community return, season-driven drama), agent communication style, C# code style conventions (PascalCase, _camelCase fields, ReactiveUnity Reactive<T> properties, Logger, NUnit asserts), common Unity patterns (RequireComponent, coroutines, Input System OnMove), tech stack notes (URP, Cinemachine, BlueOyster JSON saves, custom shaders), a complete FlyingChaser prefab setup recipe, and pointers to agent skill docs (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs).

nodes.name: IDEAS.md
nodes.summary: Design source of truth for Fishblitz. Defines the premise (player arrives in an abandoned, season-organized region and repairs it, villagers return, a disaster hits each season) and opening sequence; themes (no bad people, only bad luck, living within limits, community drama of adaptation and repair); the deliberately ambiguous Presences (River, Forest, Winter) and storytelling rules (brief dialogue, audio-overlay for long content, environment reinforces story). Details the Way North river progression with bow-and-arrow combat and stealth, the full Trail of the Brother backstory (Patrick, June, Maron, the River Presence, the player), and gameplay systems: mushroom foraging with mix-and-match traits, diet/stamina bars, box rewards (wheelbarrow/bow/crouch), birding via ScriptableObjects, drought and four transition seasons, Three Sisters farming, fire system, and fire ecology wood types.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview: Fishblitz is a top-down pixel art RPG that began as a game-jam fishing game and grew into an expansive RPG, with a link to an early demo on itch.io. Lists the core gameplay loop (fell trees, split firewood, light fires, sleep, fish, go birding) and a short 'what I've learned' section covering Unity/C# experience, design patterns, physics, shaders, and AI.

nodes.name: domain.md
nodes.summary: Agent-workflow doc telling engineering skills how to consume the repo's domain documentation before exploring: read CONTEXT.md (or CONTEXT-MAP.md pointing at per-context CONTEXT.md files) and any relevant docs/adr/ entries, proceeding silently if they are absent. Shows single-context and multi-context directory layouts, requires using the glossary's vocabulary in agent output, and demands that output contradicting an existing ADR be flagged explicitly rather than silently overridden. The /domain-modeling skill (reached via /grill-with-docs and /improve-codebase-architecture) creates these docs lazily.

nodes.name: issue-tracker.md
nodes.summary: Defines GitHub as the repo's issue tracker, driven entirely through the gh CLI with concrete conventions for creating, reading, listing, commenting on, labelling, and closing issues, plus a flag (currently 'no') controlling whether external PRs act as a triage surface. Also documents the wayfinding operations used by /wayfinder: a wayfinder:map issue holding child tickets linked as GitHub sub-issues with native blocked_by dependencies, a frontier query that drops blocked or assigned children, and claim/resolve workflows.

Skills that mention a role apply the local label string from this table; the right-hand column is meant to be edited to match whatever vocabulary this repo actually uses.

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics2D.cs

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics2D
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween shortcuts for Rigidbody2D: move/rotate tweens, jump sequence, and path tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleSprite

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUI.cs

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUI
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween shortcuts for Unity UI components, from CanvasGroup fades to RectTransform jump/shake and Text counter tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUnityVersion.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module with Unity-version-gated helpers: Material gradient/offset/tiling tweens, coroutine yield instructions (WaitForCompletion/Rewind/Kill/ElapsedLoops/Position/Start via DOTweenCYInstruction), and async/await waiters for tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUnityVersion
nodes.summary: Static class of Unity-version-dependent DOTween shortcuts: material gradient/offset tweens and coroutine/async waiters.

nodes.name: DOTweenCYInstruction
nodes.summary: Container of CustomYieldInstruction subclasses (WaitForCompletion, WaitForRewind, WaitForKill, WaitForElapsedLoops, WaitForPosition, WaitForStart) letting tweens be yielded from coroutines.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUtils.cs

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUtils

nodes.name: AudioManager.cs
nodes.summary: Global audio service exposed as static AudioManager.Instance. PlayMusic sets a looping music clip and fades it in over 2s; PlaySFX/PlayLoopingSFX play SoundData clips with randomized volume/pitch; looping SFX re-fire with organic spacing via a coroutine and can fade in/out, returning a stop action.
nodes.languageNotes: Static singleton with `Instance` property; coroutines for fade and organic loop timing; `[SerializeField] Logger` for warnings.

nodes.name: AudioManager
nodes.summary: Singleton MonoBehaviour (AudioManager.Instance) orchestrating music, one-shot SFX, and organic looping SFX with fade/randomization.
nodes.languageNotes: All entry points are static and route through `Instance`; coroutines managed on the singleton GameObject.

nodes.name: PlayMusic
nodes.summary: Static: loads a clip on the looping music AudioSource, optionally fading in over FADE_DURATION_SECS (2s), and returns a stop action that halts the source.

nodes.name: PlaySFX
nodes.summary: Static: plays a SoundData clip once on a provided AudioSource, applying configured volume and pitch variation via Random.Range.

nodes.name: PlayLoopingSFX
nodes.summary: Static: plays a looping SoundData clip with optional fade-in and organic loop spacing (LoopWithOrganicVariation), returning a stop action that fades out or stops.

nodes.name: LoopWithOrganicVariation
nodes.summary: Coroutine that watches for clip end and replays it scheduled with random wait spacing (LoopSpacing * LoopVariationPct) and per-repeat pitch/volume variation.

nodes.name: FadeInAudio
nodes.summary: Coroutine that lerps an AudioSource volume from 0 to targetVolume over the given duration.

nodes.name: FadeOutAudio
nodes.summary: Coroutine that lerps an AudioSource volume down to 0 over the given duration then stops it.

nodes.name: Bootstrapper.cs
nodes.summary: Scene bootstrap that instantiates persistent prefabs (DontDestroyOnLoad, deduped by name), all-scene prefabs, then scene-type-specific (Inside/Outside) prefabs from a BootstrapperConfig, then destroys itself.

nodes.name: Bootstrapper
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that instantiates persistent/all-scene/Inside-or-Outside prefabs from a BootstrapperConfig and then removes itself.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Instantiates persistent prefabs, all-scene prefabs, and the scene-type-specific set, then destroys the Bootstrapper GameObject.

nodes.name: InstantiatePrefabs
nodes.summary: Instantiates each non-null prefab in the array, skipping already-present persistent ones and marking persistent instances DontDestroyOnLoad.

nodes.name: PersistentExists
nodes.summary: Static check that a prefab name or its '(Clone)' counterpart is already present in the scene, used to avoid double-spawning persistent objects.

nodes.name: DynamicPixelPerfectCamera.cs
nodes.summary: Pixel-perfect orthographic camera that follows the player, clamps within a world Collider2D bounds, recomputes ortho size when resolution changes (height-based scaling with pixelsPerUnit/scaleFactor), and forces fullscreen on start.
nodes.languageNotes: LateUpdate follow with bounds clamping; serialized pixelsPerUnit (32) and minimum height; tracks via FindGameObjectWithTag("Player").

nodes.name: DynamicPixelPerfectCamera
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour camera controller providing pixel-perfect orthographic sizing, resolution-change handling, and player/world-bounds-follow.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Detects screen resolution changes and recomputes the camera's orthographic size via UpdateOrthoSize.

nodes.name: LateUpdate
nodes.summary: Moves the camera to the tracked player position, clamped horizontally/vertically to the world collider bounds minus camera extents.

nodes.name: UpdateOrthoSize
nodes.summary: Computes orthographic size from screen height, pixelsPerUnit and scaleFactor so the pixel grid stays aligned.

nodes.name: DynamicSpriteSorting.cs
nodes.summary: Utility that continuously sets a SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup sortingOrder from -Y position (y-sort), so sprites depth-sort by world height. Asserts one of the two components exists.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses UnityEngine.Assertions.Assert.IsTrue in Update; ordering derived from `-RoundToInt(y * 100)`.

nodes.name: DynamicSpriteSorting
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that y-sorts a SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup each frame based on world Y position.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Asserts a renderer exists and assigns sortingOrder = -RoundToInt(y * 100) to the SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup.

nodes.name: FloodDamage.cs
nodes.summary: On start, if WorldState.WaterState is Flood, destroys 'impermanent' child objects whose world position falls on a tile of any serialized damaged-area Tilemap, applying flood damage to the scene.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses WorldToCell + HasTile to decide which impermanent objects are submerged; reads the shared WorldState singleton.

nodes.name: FloodDamage
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that destroys impermanent objects standing on flood-tile tilemaps when the world is in a flood state.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Looks up the Impermanent parent and triggers DestroyDamagedObjects if the current water state is Flood.

nodes.name: DestroyDamagedObjects
nodes.summary: Destroys every impermanent child that sits on a tile of any damaged-area tilemap.

nodes.name: GameClock.cs
nodes.summary: Singleton in-game clock. Accumulates real time into game minutes (configurable day length in real minutes), derives minute/hour/day/season/year and current day period from elapsed minutes, fires OnGameMinute/Hour/Day/Season/YearTick events, supports skipping/pausing time, and exposes a GameIsPaused Reactive<bool>.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity `Reactive<bool>` for pause state; nested DayPeriodRange/Seasons/DayPeriods enums; all time derived from a single `_gameMinutesElapsed` int.

nodes.name: GameClock
nodes.summary: Singleton MonoBehaviour (GameClock.Instance) implementing the full game time system: minutes->year derivation, day-period ranges, tick events, and pause controls.
nodes.languageNotes: Public enums Seasons/DayPeriods and ITickable interface nested inside; properties compute values lazily from `_gameMinutesElapsed`.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Accumulates Time.deltaTime and calls IncrementGameMinute each real-time second corresponding to one game minute, unless the clock is paused.

nodes.name: IncrementGameMinute
nodes.summary: Advances _gameMinutesElapsed by one and invokes minute/hour/day/season/year tick events at the appropriate boundaries.

nodes.name: InitializeClock
nodes.summary: Derives _gameMinutesElapsed from the serialized start day/hour/minute/season/year and logs the current time.

nodes.name: SkipToTime
nodes.summary: Fast-forwards the clock to a given day/hour/minute within the current season, stepping minute-by-minute so tick events fire.

nodes.name: SkipTime
nodes.summary: Advances the clock by the given number of minutes, firing tick events per minute.

nodes.name: CalculateElapsedGameMinutesSinceTime
nodes.summary: Static helper returning how many game minutes have passed since a recorded _gameMinutesElapsed snapshot.

nodes.name: PauseGame
nodes.summary: Sets GameIsPaused true and Time.timeScale to 0, guarding against double-pause.

nodes.name: ResumeGame
nodes.summary: Clears GameIsPaused and restores Time.timeScale to 1.

nodes.name: GridCursor.cs
nodes.summary: Player-facing grid cursor with 8 directional visual cursors that swap as the player's facing direction changes (subscribed via PlayerMovement.Direction OnChange). Exposes GridPosition and Collider, and provides FindObjectAtGridCursor<T> (physics overlap) and FindInteractableTileMapByTags (tagged Tilemap lookup).
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity `OnChange` subscription for direction; Assert.IsNotNull on PlayerMovement and Grid; uses Physics2D.OverlapCollider.

nodes.name: GridCursor
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour managing the player's on-grid cursor: direction-based cursor swap, grid position/collider access, and generic lookup helpers.

nodes.name: SetCursorForPlayerDirection
nodes.summary: Swaps _activeCursor to the visual cursor matching the player's current CompassDirection (N/E/S/W plus diagonals).

nodes.name: FindObjectAtGridCursor
nodes.summary: Generic: overlaps the cursor collider with Physics2D and returns the first component of type T found, warning if several match.

nodes.name: FindInteractableTileMapByTags
nodes.summary: Searches all Tilemaps for one whose tag is in the supplied list and that has a tile at the cursor's grid position, returning the first matching tag.

nodes.name: HeatSensitive.cs
nodes.summary: Tracks ambient IHeatSource in range, gathered from serialized MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject source lists, recomputes the hottest Temperature into a protected Reactive<Temperature>, prunes destroyed sources, and exposes Temperature via AddHeatSource/RemoveHeatSource.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity `Reactive<Temperature>`; serialized source lists are converted to an IHeatSource working list in Awake.

nodes.name: HeatSensitive
nodes.summary: Abstract-ish MonoBehaviour (Serializable) that sums in-range IHeatSources and reports the hottest ambient Temperature, with add/remove APIs.

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.summary: Virtual property that recomputes and returns the current hottest ambient temperature value.

nodes.name: AddHeatSource
nodes.summary: Registers an IHeatSource into the serialized lists and working list, then refreshes ambient temperature.

nodes.name: RemoveHeatSource
nodes.summary: Unregisters an IHeatSource from the lists and refreshes ambient temperature.

nodes.name: SetAmbientTemperature
nodes.summary: Protected virtual that writes the hottest source temperature into the Reactive _ambientTemperature.

nodes.name: GetTemperatureOfHottestSource
nodes.summary: Scans the working IHeatSource list, discarding nulls, and returns the numerically largest Temperature.

nodes.name: HeatSource.cs
nodes.summary: Declares the Temperature enum (Freezing, Cold, Normal, Warm, Hot — order matters as logic relies on numeric value) and the IHeatSource interface exposing a Temperature property.
nodes.languageNotes: Enum deliberately ordered cold->hot; IHeatSource implemented by both MonoBehaviours and ScriptableObjects.

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.summary: Enum of five temperature levels ordered Freezing->Hot; numeric ordering is load-bearing for heat-source comparisons.

nodes.name: IHeatSource
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by objects that emit heat, exposing a Temperature property. Implemented by both MonoBehaviours and ScriptableObjects.

nodes.name: ISaveableComponent.cs
nodes.summary: Save contract interface: components expose a ComponentId plus CaptureStateAsJson/RestoreStateFromJson so the save system can persist their state as JSON.

nodes.name: ISaveableComponent
nodes.summary: Interface contract for JSON-serializable component state used by the scene save/load system.

nodes.name: IntroManager.cs
nodes.summary: Intro/initialization flow: resets player systems (energy/drying/temperature/strength, inventory, carry, wheelbarrow), wipes the persistent data folder, optionally plays a Narrator intro, then sets a pending spawn position (named spawn or custom) and loads the initial scene via LevelChanger.

nodes.name: IntroManager
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that runs the game intro: state reset, save-data wipe, optional narrated opening, and initial scene spawn.

nodes.summary: Resets initial player state, clears saved files from persistent data path, and starts the OpeningDialogue coroutine.

nodes.name: SetInitialPlayerState
nodes.summary: Finds player energy/drying/temperature/strength managers and resets them to defaults, zeroes the active inventory slot, and clears carry/wheelbarrow state.

nodes.name: OpeningDialogue
nodes.summary: Coroutine that optionally posts narrator intro messages, waits until they clear, then loads the initial scene.

nodes.name: ClearAllFilesInPersistentDataPath
nodes.summary: Deletes every file in Application.persistentDataPath so saves from previous runs do not carry over.

nodes.name: UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour
nodes.summary: Unity's base class for all gameplay components; referenced as the inheritance root of Fishblitz MonoBehaviour scripts.

nodes.name: LocalHeatSource.cs

nodes.name: LocalHeatSource
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour heat emitter that adds itself as an IHeatSource to every HeatSensitive whose collider overlaps _heatCollider, whenever enabled or when its Temperature changes. Re-registers on enable and unregisters on disable.

nodes.name: Magnetosphere.cs
nodes.summary: Player magnet for magnetic LooseItems: items in a magnet range are pulled toward the player with an inverse-square force and collected into the Inventory when they intersect a collect collider.

nodes.name: Magnetosphere
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that tracks LooseItems in a magnet collider, applies inverse-square magnetic force toward the player, and collects any magnetic item whose bounds intersect a separate collect collider into the Inventory.

nodes.name: ApplyMagneticForce
nodes.summary: Pulls a loose item toward the player via an inverse-square Coulomb-style force (strength / radius^2) applied as an impulse on its Rigidbody2D.

nodes.name: MatchLightWithSun.cs

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/FlyingChaser.cs

nodes.name: EnterTargetingState

nodes.name: AlignHUDToMousePosition

nodes.summary: Resets current health to max whenever the enemy is enabled (pool-spawn friendly).

nodes.name: TakeDamage
nodes.summary: Applies positive damage if not invulnerable, logs the attacker from the stack trace, kills the enemy at zero health, otherwise starts invulnerability frames.

nodes.name: InvulnerabilityFrames
nodes.summary: Coroutine that flips IsInvulnerable on, waits the configured duration, then flips it off.

nodes.name: Heal
nodes.summary: Adds a positive heal amount, clamped to max health.

nodes.name: Die
nodes.summary: Logs the death and destroys the enemy GameObject.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Caches the parent EnemyHealth and asserts it exists.

nodes.name: TakeDamage
nodes.summary: Forwards damage to the parent EnemyHealth.TakeDamage.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the rigidbody and EnemyHealth and subscribes to CurrentHealth changes to detect taking damage.

nodes.name: GetPlayer
nodes.summary: Lazily finds the player by tag and caches the PlayerHurtbox transform as the chase target.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Initializes the wander target and resolves interaction layers for avoidance from the steering helper.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Periodically re-detects the player: transitions to Chasing when within view radius with no obstacle linecast, and back to Wandering when the player leaves (unless already aggressive).

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Runs the wander or chase behavior based on the current state.

nodes.name: UpdateWandering
nodes.summary: Refreshes the steering wander force on an interval, adds the wander plus avoidance force, and clamps velocity to wander speed.

nodes.name: UpdateChasing
nodes.summary: Applies a seek force toward the player plus avoidance, clamped to chase speed.

nodes.name: OnHealthChanged
nodes.summary: Reactive health callback that flips the chaser aggressive and enters Chasing the first time it takes damage.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the inventory's ActiveItemSlot reactive and re-resolves the active weapon.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Runs all stored unsubscription hooks to detach from the inventory reactive.

nodes.name: SetActiveWeapon
nodes.summary: Reads the active inventory item; clears the reloader weapon if not a ranged weapon, otherwise hands it the RangedWeaponItem with its InstanceData and assigns the spawn center/radius.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the rigidbody, sprite renderer, and child ContactHitbox, stores base damage, and subscribes to the hitbox's OnHit event.

nodes.name: OnDestroy
nodes.summary: Unsubscribes from the hitbox's OnHit event.

nodes.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
nodes.summary: Disables the projectile when it overlaps a Default-layer collider (terrain/walls).

nodes.name: Launch
nodes.summary: Starts the lifespan timeout and sets the rigidbody velocity to the direction times speed and an optional speed multiplier.

nodes.name: SetCrit
nodes.summary: Toggles crit state: yellow sprite and doubled hitbox damage when crit, white and base damage otherwise.

nodes.name: OnHitTarget
nodes.summary: Hit event handler that disables the projectile once it lands a hit.

nodes.name: DisableProjectileAfterLifespan
nodes.summary: Coroutine that waits the lifespan then disables the projectile.

nodes.name: DisableProjectile
nodes.summary: Stops the lifespan coroutine, zeroes velocity, resets crit, and returns the projectile to the object pool.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the rigidbody, sprite renderer, and EnemyHealth, records the original color, and subscribes to health changes.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Finds the player by tag, caches the PlayerHurtbox transform, and picks an initial wander target.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Runs periodic detection and, while Firing, drives the firing pattern logic.

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Runs the movement behavior matching the current state (idle wander, engage, or hold position while firing).

nodes.name: HandleDetection
nodes.summary: Periodically checks line of sight to the player within the approach radius to enter Engaging, and returns to Idle when the player is lost and the enemy is not aggressive.

nodes.name: PickNewWanderTarget
nodes.summary: Picks a random point within the wander radius around the current position as the new idle destination.

nodes.name: StopIdleWait
nodes.summary: Cancels an in-progress idle wait coroutine and clears the waiting flag.

nodes.name: UpdateIdleMovement
nodes.summary: Drifts toward the wander target at idle speed and, on arrival, starts the idle wait coroutine.

nodes.name: IdleWaitCoroutine
nodes.summary: Halts movement for a random wait duration, then picks a new wander target.

nodes.name: UpdateEngagingMovement
nodes.summary: Moves toward the player at engage speed, retreats if inside the retreat radius, and enters Firing when inside the firing band.

nodes.name: UpdateFiringMovement
nodes.summary: Holds position while firing and drops back to Engaging when the player gets too close or too far.

nodes.name: HandleFiring
nodes.summary: Gates on the fire rate and whether a firing coroutine is already active, then executes the configured pattern.

nodes.name: ExecuteFiringPattern
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the pattern-specific fire method, starting coroutines for burst and aimed shots.

nodes.name: StopActiveFireCoroutine
nodes.summary: Cancels an in-flight burst/aimed coroutine, clears the active flag, and restores the sprite color.

nodes.name: GetDirectionToPlayer
nodes.summary: Returns the normalized direction from the enemy to the player.

nodes.name: SpawnAndLaunchProjectile
nodes.summary: Spawns a pooled projectile at the spawn offset, orients it, launches it with speed/damage multipliers, and boosts the hitbox damage when the damage multiplier exceeds one.

nodes.name: FireSingleShot
nodes.summary: Launches a single projectile aimed at the player.

nodes.name: FireSpreadShot
nodes.summary: Launches a fan of projectiles across a configurable angle around the player direction.

nodes.name: FireParallelSpread
nodes.summary: Launches a line of parallel projectiles perpendicular to the aim direction at a given spacing.

nodes.name: BurstFireCoroutine
nodes.summary: Coroutine that fires N aimed shots at a fixed interval, blocking other firing while active.

nodes.name: AimedShotCoroutine
nodes.summary: Coroutine that telegraphs with a red sprite while stationary for the charge duration, then fires a faster, harder-hitting aimed shot.

nodes.name: FireRingShot
nodes.summary: Fires a full 360-degree ring of projectiles.

nodes.name: OnHealthChanged
nodes.summary: Reactive health callback that marks the enemy aggressive and jumps from Idle to Engaging on first damage.

nodes.name: ReloadBar.cs
nodes.summary: In-world progress bar for ranged weapon reloading. Subscribes to the Reloader's active weapon instance data via ReactiveUnity OnChange, shows/scales a child SpriteRenderer to the reload progress each frame while IsReloading is true.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Reactive<T>.OnChange callbacks stored as Action unsubscribe closures, an Assert.IsNotNull inspector check, and a coroutine for per-frame bar scaling.

nodes.name: Reloader.cs
nodes.summary: Drives reload and fire-cooldown timers for the player's currently equipped ranged weapon. In FixedUpdate it advances ReloadElapsed/CoolDownElapsed on the weapon's InstanceData and flips IsReloading/IsCoolingDown Reactive flags when complete, refilling the clip.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity Reactive<T> fields for the active weapon and its instance data; timer logic lives in FixedUpdate using Time.fixedDeltaTime.

nodes.name: SteeringForces.cs
nodes.summary: Static library of steering behaviors for enemy/bird AI: Seek, a wander force with a projected ring, obstacle avoidance via CircleCast, a Reynolds-style boid force (separation/alignment/cohesion over nearest IFlockMate neighbors), and a collision-mask helper that derives interaction layers from the rigidbody and layer matrix.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure static helpers returning Vector2 forces so callers sum them into their own movement; generic method over IFlockMate for boid behavior.

nodes.name: FishBarTrigger.cs
nodes.summary: A trigger zone on the fishing minigame bar. Reports when the rising cursor passes it (OnTriggerExit2D sends PassedFishBarTrigger up the hierarchy), toggles a fulfilled/unfulfilled sprite, and optionally oscillates up and down within clamped bounds at a FishingRound-configured speed.
nodes.languageNotes: SendMessageUpwards for minigame communication; oscillation driven in FixedUpdate by translating the trigger transform between local bounds.

nodes.name: FishType.cs
nodes.summary: Config ScriptableBehaviour-style component describing a catchable fish: which scenes it can be caught in, the Inventory.Item it grants, spawnable seasons/day periods, and a list of FishingRound minigame difficulty configs (speed, trigger count/spacing, stacking modifier, oscillation).

nodes.name: FishingGame.cs
nodes.summary: The fishing minigame. Picks a valid FishType for the current scene/season/period, runs one or more rounds where a rising cursor passes trigger bars the player must time with the use key, handles hit/miss detection via Overlap, and on win awards the fish item + capture-log entry while on fail shakes and launches the cursor.
nodes.languageNotes: Static singleton Instance; static readonly TRIGGER_MAPPING_* constants map normalized positions (y=mx+b) to the bar; coroutine-driven rounds; DOTween DOShakePosition for the fail shake; Logger for round/fish diagnostics.

nodes.name: Axe.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject axe item. Sets the player to the Axing state and triggers OnUseAxe on world objects that implement IUseableWithAxe (trees/stumps), playing a chop sound; costs energy.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item ScriptableObject implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject / IUsableWithoutTarget / IEnergyDepleting; nested interface IUseableWithAxe for targets.

nodes.name: Binoculars.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject binoculars item that switches the player into the Birding state and starts the birding minigame via BirdingGame.Instance.Play(this), passing beam rotation/acceleration and charge/cursor timing settings; costs energy.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item ScriptableObject; exposes tuning floats for the birding cursor beam, consumed by BirdingGame.

nodes.name: Bow.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject bow ranged weapon. On use, hands off to BowChargeController.StartCharge when a projectile spawn point exists (charged shots with crit window), otherwise fires immediately via TryFire; exposes charge time, min-speed multiplier, and crit-shot charge range.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends RangedWeaponItem (fire rate/clip/reload); interfaces with BowChargeController attached to the projectile spawn center GameObject.

nodes.name: DryLog.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject dry-log item placed on world objects: loads into a LarchStump or adds to a WoodRack, consuming the active inventory item and playing a placement sound on success.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject with type-check pattern-matching against LarchStump/WoodRack.

nodes.name: Firewood.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject firewood item that adds fuel to a WoodStove or Campfire, consuming the active inventory item and playing a placement sound on success.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject; pattern-matches WoodStove/Campfire and calls AddFirewood().

nodes.name: Fly Agaric 1.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom variant (fly agaric 1). Edible food: removing the active item and calling Diet.EatFood against the player's energy manager to recover protein/carbs/nutrients.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; identical to the other Fly Agaric variants apart from the asset class name.

nodes.name: Fly Agaric 2.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom variant (fly agaric 2). Edible food: removes the active item and feeds it to the player's energy manager via Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; near-duplicate of the other Fly Agaric variants.

nodes.name: Fly Agaric.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom item. Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients to the player via Diet.EatFood.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; base variant of the near-duplicate Fly Agaric 1/2 scripts.

nodes.name: Hammer.cs
nodes.summary: Empty ScriptableObject hammer item marker used for gifting/crafting progression; carries no behavior beyond being an Inventory.Item.

nodes.name: Kokanee.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject kokanee salmon item. Both a gift (UseOnWorldObject hands it to IGiftReceiving targets like NPCs via TryGiveGift) and an edible food (Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients).
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood plus both IUsableWithoutTarget and IUsableOnWorldObject for eat-or-gift dual use.

nodes.name: Larch Bolete 2.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom variant (bolete 2). Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; near-duplicate of the other Larch Bolete variants.

nodes.name: Larch Bolete 3.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom variant (bolete 3). Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; near-duplicate of the other Larch Bolete variants.

nodes.name: Larch Bolete.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom item. Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; base variant of the near-duplicate Larch Bolete 2/3 scripts.

nodes.name: LooseItem.cs
nodes.summary: World-space dropped item holding an Inventory.ItemStack and an animator; becomes magnetically attractable to the player once its animation reaches the Idle state (so it can't be grabbed mid-drop).
nodes.languageNotes: MonoBehaviour with [RequireComponent(typeof(Animator))]; polls the current animator state name in Update to gate IsMagnetic.

nodes.name: RainbowTrout.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject rainbow trout item. Both a gift (UseOnWorldObject hands it to IGiftReceiving targets via TryGiveGift) and an edible food (Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients); zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood plus both IUsableWithoutTarget and IUsableOnWorldObject for eat-or-gift dual use.

nodes.name: Rod.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fishing rod item used on tilemaps: casting on the Water tilemap starts fishing (FishingGame.CastForFish) while already fishing reels the line in, toggling the player between Fishing and Idle states; costs energy.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnTileMap; drives FishingGame.Instance lifecycle based on the cursor tilemap layer name.

nodes.name: Sling.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject sling ranged weapon that fires instantly on use via RangedWeaponItem.TryFire, with a per-shot energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends RangedWeaponItem; the smallest weapon script — a one-line UseWithoutTarget that forwards to TryFire.

nodes.name: SpawnLooseItemsOnDestroy.cs
nodes.summary: Spawns configured loose items from a collider when the object is disabled, unless disabled by a scene unload (checks gameObject.scene.isLoaded); items are launched with velocity and drag. Named OnDestroy but hooks OnDisable to exclude scene-exit destruction.
nodes.languageNotes: MonoBehaviour; wraps SpawnItems.SpawnItemsFromCollider and guards against scene unload so loot doesn't spawn during saves.

nodes.name: WetLog.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject wet-log item. Trying to burn it on a WoodStove/Campfire posts a 'too wet to burn' dialogue message, while placing it on a WoodRack dries it (TryAddWetLog), consuming the active item.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject; dialogue feedback via PlayerDialogue.Instance.PostMessage.

nodes.name: ReloadBar
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that visually mirrors the active ranged weapon's reload state by scaling a child progress-bar SpriteRenderer; subscribes/unsubscribes to ReactiveUnity change events for the active weapon and its IsReloading flag.

nodes.name: Reloader
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour holding the active RangedWeaponItem and its InstanceData as Reactive properties; in FixedUpdate it advances reload and cooldown timers, refills the clip and clears the flags when done. CoolDownTime derives from the weapon's shots-per-second.

nodes.name: IFlockMate
nodes.summary: Interface exposing a flock neighbor's Position and Velocity so generic boid behavior can run against any moving entity (enemies, birds).

nodes.name: SteeringForces
nodes.summary: Static steering math library: Seek, wander ring, CircleCast-based avoidance, boid separation/alignment/cohesion, and a LayerMask builder from the rigidbody's ignore matrix.

nodes.name: FishBarTrigger
nodes.summary: Minigame trigger bar: swaps between fulfilled/unfulfilled sprites, reports when the cursor passes it, and optionally oscillates vertically within clamped play-area bounds for harder rounds.

nodes.name: FishType
nodes.summary: Component describing a catchable species: scene whitelist, granted Inventory.Item, spawnable seasons/day periods, and its list of FishingRound minigame difficulty configs.

nodes.name: FishingRound
nodes.summary: Serializable per-round minigame config: game speed, trigger count/spacing, stacked-trigger modifier (none/doubles/mega), and optional trigger oscillation speed/length.

nodes.name: FishingGame
nodes.summary: Singleton minigame orchestrator: picks a valid fish, runs timed rounds with a rising cursor passing trigger bars, handles the use-key hit/miss check, and resolves win (reward + capture log) or fail (shake, blink, cursor launch).

nodes.name: Axe
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject axe tool; sets the Axing player state and invokes OnUseAxe on IUseableWithAxe targets, with a chop SFX and energy cost.

nodes.name: Binoculars
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject birding tool; enters the Birding player state and launches BirdingGame with configurable beam/charge/cursor tuning; costs energy.

nodes.name: Bow
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject bow weapon with charged shots: delegates to BowChargeController when a projectile spawn center exists, else fires immediately; exposes charge/min-speed/crit settings and energy cost.

nodes.name: DryLog
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject dry-log placement item for loading into LarchStumps or WoodRacks.

nodes.name: Firewood
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fuel item added to WoodStoves and Campfires.

nodes.name: FlyAgaric1
nodes.summary: Edible fly-agaric mushroom ScriptableObject (variant 1); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients.

nodes.name: FlyAgaric2
nodes.summary: Edible fly-agaric mushroom ScriptableObject (variant 2); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients.

nodes.name: FlyAgaric
nodes.summary: Edible fly-agaric mushroom ScriptableObject (base variant); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients.

nodes.name: Hammer
nodes.summary: Marker ScriptableObject hammer item with no behavior of its own.

nodes.name: Kokanee
nodes.summary: Kokanee salmon ScriptableObject usable as a gift to IGiftReceiving NPCs or eaten for nutrition.

nodes.name: LarchBolete2
nodes.summary: Edible larch bolete mushroom ScriptableObject (variant 2); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients at zero energy cost.

nodes.name: LarchBolete3
nodes.summary: Edible larch bolete mushroom ScriptableObject (variant 3); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients at zero energy cost.

nodes.name: LarchBolete
nodes.summary: Edible larch bolete mushroom ScriptableObject (base variant); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients at zero energy cost.

nodes.name: LooseItem
nodes.summary: World-space dropped item with an Inventory.ItemStack that becomes magnetic to the player once its drop animation reaches Idle.

nodes.name: RainbowTrout
nodes.summary: Rainbow trout ScriptableObject usable as a gift to IGiftReceiving NPCs or eaten for nutrition.

nodes.name: Rod
nodes.summary: Fishing rod ScriptableObject that casts on Water tilemaps and reels in when already fishing, toggling player state and driving FishingGame.

nodes.name: Sling
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject sling weapon that fires instantly via TryFire with an energy cost.

nodes.name: SpawnLooseItemsOnDisable
nodes.summary: Spawns configured loose items from a collider on OnDisable unless the scene is unloading, launching them with velocity/drag.

nodes.name: WetLog
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject wet-log item: refused by fire sources with a dialogue message but accepted by WoodRack for drying.

nodes.name: SetActiveWeapon
nodes.summary: Assigns the equipped weapon and its instance data to the Reloader's Reactive properties, which ReloadBar and friends subscribe to.

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Every fixed tick, advances reload and cooldown timers on the active weapon's instance data when their flags are set.

nodes.name: UpdateReloading
nodes.summary: Increments ReloadElapsed; when it reaches the weapon's reload time, resets it and refills the clip to full, clearing IsReloading.

nodes.name: UpdateCooldown
nodes.summary: Increments CoolDownElapsed; clears IsCoolingDown once it exceeds the fire-rate-derived cooldown time.

nodes.name: Seek
nodes.summary: Steering force steering toward a target position, clamped to a force limit from the difference between desired and current velocity.

nodes.name: CalculateWanderForce
nodes.summary: Projects a wander ring ahead of the entity, picks a random point on it (returned via ref/out), and Seeks it for wandering motion.

nodes.name: CalculateAvoidanceForce
nodes.summary: CircleCasts ahead along the velocity; on a non-trigger obstacle, pushes away proportionally to proximity, weighting by an avoidance factor and exposing the obstacle point.

nodes.name: CalculateBoidForce
nodes.summary: Computes a Reynolds-style boid force over the nearest IFlockMate neighbors (bounded by maxMates): weighted separation, alignment, and cohesion combined into a single normalized force.

nodes.name: GetInteractionLayers
nodes.summary: Builds a LayerMask from the global layer-collision matrix minus the object's own layer, then applies the rigidbody's excludeLayers/includeLayers overrides.

nodes.name: Play
nodes.summary: Boots the minigame: activates all UI pieces, caches player/cursor colliders and the cursor rigidbody, initializes a new game and first round, and starts the round coroutine.

nodes.name: CastForFish
nodes.summary: Starts a coroutine that waits a random bite-time range before Play() is called; called by the Rod item.

nodes.name: ReelInLine
nodes.summary: Stops the waiting-for-bite coroutine so the player can cancel a cast before the minigame starts.

nodes.name: UpdateGameCursor
nodes.summary: Interpolates the cursor and stretching bar-fill between start and end height by a 0-1 progress value, freezing the cursor if the round already failed.

nodes.name: PassedFishBarTrigger
nodes.summary: Message received from FishBarTrigger via SendMessageUpwards: marks the game failed if an unfulfilled trigger was passed.

nodes.name: InitializeNewGame
nodes.summary: Resets game-wide state: starts the reeling-in loop SFX, locks the player into Catching, picks a random valid fish, snapshots season/period, and resets failure flag and round counter.

nodes.name: InitializeNewRound
nodes.summary: Clears and rebuilds the trigger bars for a round from generated normalized positions, optionally arming oscillation.

nodes.name: PlayRound
nodes.summary: Core timing loop: advances the cursor over the round duration, breaks early on failure, then either fails the game, wins (last round), or recursively launches the next round.

nodes.name: OnUseItem
nodes.summary: The keypress handler: while fishing/catching, overlaps the cursor against triggers and fulfills the lowest unfulfilled one; no hit means an instant miss.

nodes.name: HandleGameWin
nodes.summary: On success: celebrates, plays the caught SFX, adds the fish item to inventory (or drops), logs the capture, stops the reel SFX, and hides the minigame UI.

nodes.name: HandleGameFail
nodes.summary: On failure: shakes the bar via DOTween and runs the red/grey blink + cursor-launch failure coroutine.

nodes.name: GenerateNormalizedTriggerPositions
nodes.summary: Procedurally places 0-1 normalized trigger positions per round modifier: singles with minimum spacing, pairs (doubles), or a stacked mega-cluster; always reserves 1.0 for the final trigger, then sorts.

nodes.name: InstantiateTriggers
nodes.summary: Spawns FishBarTrigger prefabs under the triggers container, mapping normalized positions to world bar space via the TRIGGER_MAPPING linear formula.

nodes.name: GetRandomValidFishType
nodes.summary: Filters child FishType components by current scene, season, and day period, logs diagnostics, and picks one at random.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Spawns the configured loose items from the collider with launch velocity/drag, but only if the game object's scene is still loaded (skips scene-exit destruction).

nodes.name: AnimateTitle.cs
nodes.summary: Title-screen text that breathes: stores the original local scale in Awake and in every Update oscillates transform.localScale around it with Mathf.Sin(Time.time * _speed) * _scaleFactor.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Mathf.Sin and Time.time in Update for a frame-rate-bound sine pulse; no tween library involved.

nodes.name: AnimateTitle
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that pulses the title text scale with a sine wave each frame between original scale +/- _scaleFactor.

nodes.name: BlinkRepeatedly.cs
nodes.summary: Blinks a PixelTextRenderer by looping forever in a Start coroutine: shows the original text, waits _visibleInterval, clears Text to empty, waits _invisibleInterval, then restores it.
nodes.languageNotes: Start is declared as IEnumerator so Unity runs it as a coroutine; uses WaitForSeconds in an infinite while loop.

nodes.name: BlinkRepeatedly
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that alternates a PixelTextRenderer's Text between its original value and empty on a repeating interval.

nodes.name: KeepChildScaleUnflipped.cs
nodes.summary: Keeps a child sprite visually unflipped when its parent is mirrored: in LateUpdate it rewrites local scale to the initial magnitude times the sign of each parent axis.
nodes.languageNotes: LateUpdate so the counter-flip applies after the parent's own scale/rotation is set in Update.

nodes.name: KeepChildScaleUnflipped
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that inverts this transform's local scale sign to cancel a flipped parent, preserving the original scale magnitude.

nodes.name: PulseLight.cs
nodes.summary: Breathes a URP 2D Light2D's intensity between _minIntensity and _maxIntensity every frame by stepping the intensity; SetIntensity retunes the range and snaps intensity to the new minimum.
nodes.languageNotes: RequireComponent(typeof(Light2D)) guarantees the cached component in Awake; step-based (per-frame) intensity change rather than a tween.

nodes.name: PulseLight
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour oscillating a Light2D intensity up and down each frame between configurable min and max values.

nodes.name: SetIntensity
nodes.summary: Public method that sets the pulse min/max intensity range and immediately resets light intensity to the new minimum.

nodes.name: StartGame.cs
nodes.summary: Title-screen handler that loads the 'Level 1' scene through SmoothSceneManager when the Space key is pressed in Update.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses legacy Input.GetKeyDown rather than the new Input System.

nodes.name: StartGame
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour watching for Space and starting the game via SmoothSceneManager.LoadScene.

nodes.name: AsepriteEventListener.cs
nodes.summary: Bridges Animator event callbacks from Aseprite player animations to configurable local transform offsets: each Effect pairs an affected GameObject with an event name (airborne, grounded, squats, pickups) and an offset; originals are snapshotted on enable and the same event drives offsetting.
nodes.languageNotes: RequireComponent(typeof(Animator)); event handlers are named to match animation events and dedupe via a stored _lastEvent.

nodes.name: AsepriteEventListener
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that applies per-animation-event transform offsets to child sprites, deduping repeated events.

nodes.name: TransformLocalData
nodes.summary: Nested serializable snapshot of a transform's local position, rotation and scale, captured before any event offset is applied.

nodes.name: Effect
nodes.summary: Nested serializable binding of an affected GameObject, the animation event that triggers it, and the transform offset to apply.

nodes.name: ApplyEventEffects
nodes.summary: Applies the configured offsets for a given animation event, skipping repeated dispatches of the same event.

nodes.name: UpdateTransform
nodes.summary: Writes the stored original local position, rotation and scale plus the effect's offset into the affected GameObject's transform.

nodes.name: CaptureLog.cs
nodes.summary: Serializable capture journal shared by fishing and birding. AddToLog stamps a CaptureEntry with the full GameClock timestamp (year, season, day, hour, minute) and reports first captures; queries count totals, unique names, per-name totals, per-week counts, a 4x3 season/week presence table, and existence checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure [System.Serializable] class, not a MonoBehaviour; reads time from the GameClock.Instance singleton rather than the system clock.

nodes.name: CaptureLog
nodes.summary: Serializable log of capture rows with helper queries for first captures, totals, weekly counts, and a season x week presence table.

nodes.name: CaptureEntry
nodes.summary: Nested serializable row holding a species name and the GameClock year/season/day/hour/minute it was caught.

nodes.name: AddToLog
nodes.summary: Adds a CaptureEntry stamped from GameClock.Instance and returns true when the name has never been caught before.

nodes.name: GetTotalCaptures
nodes.summary: Returns the total number of logged captures.

nodes.name: GetUniqueCaptureCount
nodes.summary: Returns the count of distinct captured names using a HashSet.

nodes.name: GetCaptureCountForName
nodes.summary: Returns how many times a given name appears in the log.

nodes.name: GetCaptureCountForNameThisWeek
nodes.summary: Counts captures of a name within the current GameClock season/week (weeks are 5-day buckets).

nodes.name: GetSeasonWeekTable
nodes.summary: Builds a 4x3 bool table of whether a name was caught in each season/week bucket.

nodes.name: HasBeenCaught
nodes.summary: Returns whether a given name exists anywhere in the log.

nodes.name: CarriedObjectsAnimatorController.cs

nodes.summary: HLSL include (Shader Graph Custom Function) providing two antialiased wedge-mask functions — a circular wedge fill and a UV wedge cutout — used by birding shaders to draw radial wedge shapes and angle-range masks.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom Function nodes for Unity Shader Graph; functions follow the _float suffix convention (inputs/outputs of float4 with out params). Uses atan2, fwidth/ddx/ddy for antialiased edges.

nodes.name: CircularWedge_float
nodes.summary: Outputs an antialiased mask for a circular wedge: radius check via distance with fwidth-based edge softening, plus an angle-range test (in radians, handling ranges that cross 0).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses atan2 for angle, fwidth(dist) for antialiasing, saturate for the edge gradient.

nodes.name: WedgeCutout_float
nodes.summary: Cuts a wedge out of a UV: builds an angular step mask for the angle range and antialiases the wedge edges using the ddx/ddy angular gradient, leaving the rest of the UV visible.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses step() for angle masks and abs(ddx(theta)) + abs(ddy(theta)) for angular antialiasing.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and the design source of truth to understand the game vision: a top-down pixel RPG about repairing an abandoned, season-organized region. IDEAS.md spells out the no-villains, adaptation-and-repair philosophy, the ambiguous Presences, the Trail of the Brother backstory, and the planned systems. AGENTS.md covers the code conventions and ReactiveUnity patterns you will see everywhere.

tour.title: Boot Sequence
tour.description: There is no classic entry point — Unity scenes bootstrap themselves. Bootstrapper.cs reads a BootstrapperConfig ScriptableObject to spawn persistent and per-scene prefabs, IntroManager resets player state and starts a fresh run, and StartGame launches the first level. LevelChanger, SmoothSceneManager, and SceneTransitionOverlay together handle scene loads with a fade overlay that survives scene unloads.

tour.title: Core Systems: Clock, Save & Spawning
tour.description: The two pillars everything else hangs off: GameClock (real time accumulated into game minutes/hours/days/seasons with tick events) and the JSON save pipeline. Persistence serializes with Newtonsoft, SaveData defines the ISaveable per-world-object contract, and SceneSaveLoadManager snapshots each scene's Impermanent container plus global player state. WorldState holds global water/rain/wind/temperature as static reactives that WorldStateByCalendar rewrites each day; SceneSpawner scatters world objects from tilemap markers on first visit.

tour.title: Player: Movement & Interaction
tour.description: How the player is driven. PlayerMovement reads input and derives an 8-way CompassDirection plus PlayerStates, with speeds tuned in PlayerMovementData and animation driven by PlayerAnimatorController. The grid-based interaction model lives in GridCursor (find targets under the cursor), PlayerCursor (the four directional cursors), InteractInput (resolves IInteractable targets), UseItem (routes items to world objects/tilemaps), and PlayerCrouch (stealth state).

tour.title: Player: Inventory, Carry & Health
tour.description: The resource model behind scarcity as a design lever. Inventory is a 10-slot ScriptableObject that persists to JSON, WeightyObjectStack + WeightyObjectType implement the weight-capped carry system with per-object weight and strength requirements, PlayerCarry handles pick-up/put-down, PlayerStrength and its tiers gate capacity, and PlayerWheelBarrow lets the player haul the whole barrow. PlayerHealth/PlayerHurtbox define damage absorption — taking a hit drops a carried item instead of health, tying combat risk back to the carry loop.

tour.title: The Fishing Loop
tour.description: Fishblitz began as a fishing game — this is the deepest core loop. Rod is the item that casts onto the Water tilemap and drives the state transition, FishingGame runs the timing minigame (rising cursor vs. trigger bars, configured per-fish in FishType), and FishBarTrigger is the hit-detection zone on the bar. MountedRod/PlacedMountedRod add the placed-rod variant on water tiles, and CaptureLog stamps catches with full game-clock timestamps for the journal.

tour.title: The Birding Loop
tour.description: The second primary loop, and a showcase for the project's steering AI. Binoculars flips the player into the birding state; BirdingGame is the frame-charge + tag minigame HUD, BirdingWinFrame the celebration overlay. On the world side, BirdBrain is a state machine spread across sibling files (flee, ground, perch, high/low flight), BirdSpeciesData are ScriptableObject species definitions, BirdSpawner places birds per season/week, and BirdFrightDetector triggers evasion when the player gets close.

tour.title: Survival: Temperature, Wetness, Energy & Sleep
tour.description: The living-limits simulation that makes the environment the antagonist. PlayerTemperatureManager drifts the player's dry temperature toward ambient (from OutsideTemperature, a singleton IHeatSource) and drops it while wet; PlayerDryingManager tracks the Wet/Dry state machine driven by rain. HeatSource/HeatSensitive/LocalHeatSource are the ambient-heat plumbing that fires and stoves plug into. PlayerEnergyManager is the central energy/diet state, Diet handles daily nutrition intake, and SleepMenu runs the end-of-day recovery sequence.

tour.title: World Objects: Trees, Wood & Fire
tour.description: The README's core loop in code: fell trees, split wood, dry it, burn it. TreePlant is the abstract choppable seasonal tree (Larch/Spruce and FallenLarch/FallenSpruce are concrete variants) and FallenTree the five-hit axe target. LarchStump is the firewood-crafting station that splits a dry log into firewood, Axe/DryLog are the tool and input items, and WoodRack dries wet logs over game minutes. Campfire and WoodStove run the fire lifecycle (Dead/Ready/Hot/Embers) that produces the warmth the survival step depends on.

tour.title: Combat & Enemies
tour.description: The weaponized conflict for the Way North. BasicWeapon defines RangedWeaponItem (fire-rate, clip, reload, projectile prefab) shared by bow and sling, BowChargeController choreographs the charge/crit window, and Projectile is the pooled round that deals damage. Damage flows through ContactHitbox → IHurtBox, with EnemyHealth/EnemyHurtbox on the receiving side. On the AI side, FlyingChaser wanders, sees the player with line-of-sight checks, then chases; ProjectileFiringEnemy keeps range and executes six shot patterns.

tour.title: Narrative & Characters
tour.description: Story is told through play, not interruption. Narrator is the scene-level overlay that queues brief pixel-text lines (unscaled time, so it works during pause). DialogueController renders speech bubbles, Gerard tracks the rescue arc as a three-stage ScriptableObject state machine, with UnconsciousGerard and ShedGerard as its two in-world variants, and IGiftable defines the gift-receiving contract (feeding the unconscious Gerard is how the player advances his story). Journal + JournalEntry render the Trail of the Brother notebook from the capture logs.

tour.title: UI & Rendering
tour.description: How the pixel-art look is produced. DynamicPixelPerfectCamera keeps an orthographic camera pixel-perfect (with CinemachinePixelSnap snapping to the grid during Finalize), PixelFont maps characters to glyph sprites, and PixelTextRenderer/PixelCanvasTextRenderer lay out crisp pixel text in world and screen space — everything from speech bubbles to the HUD uses them. TopRightHUD shows the clock/season from GameClock ticks, ItemSlot is the hotbar widget with drag-drop, and EnergyBar renders the energy meter.

tour.title: The Way North Zone System
tour.description: The procedural river progression mentioned in the design doc, implemented as a generated binary tree of biome nodes. TheWayNorth.cs is the manager — it builds a weighted tree from TheWayNorthConfig and BiomeConfig (weighted scene pools + fork scenes), tracks the traversal path with return links between exits and entrances, and persists the whole network. WeightedScene is the pickable scene entry, and the entrance/exit/spawn/transition components wire individual scenes into the graph.

tour.title: Project Config & Next Steps
tour.description: The dependency and input contract for the whole project, plus the forward-looking task list. manifest.json pins the stack (URP 17, Cinemachine, Input System 1.18, BlueOyster git package for ReactiveUnity + JSON saves) and fish blitz.inputactions defines the six input maps (Player, Birding, PlayerBarrowing, Combat, UI, Menu) the scripts reference. TODOS.md is the working task list — the practical starting point if you want to extend the game.
